Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world. You will design and build the software systems that enable MEGA’s machine learning research. **Job Summary And Qualifications**
 The Residency Program at Centerpoint Medical Center provides you with the tools necessary to succeed in today’s hospital environment. This paid program will assist you with the transition out of the classroom setting through a formalized series of learning experiences, including:

 The RN Resident coordinates and delivers high quality, patient\-centered care in accordance with the nature and specific requirements of the department, and consistent with the scope and standards of practice for the relevant state and specialty. In collaboration with medical providers and other members of the care team, the RN Resident provides individualized, comprehensive, and compassionate care using established nursing models such as “Assess, Perform, Teach, and Manage.” The RN Resident serves as an advocate for patients, families and caregivers to support an unparalleled patient experience.
   

  

 What will you do in this role:
   

  

* Assess patient condition during admission and during each shift as scheduled, identifying and reporting any changes in patient status.
* Perform procedures, monitoring, or other functions as ordered by the medical provider(s). Document the administration of care in the patient medical record in a timely and thorough manner.
* Perform the administration of prescribed medications. Monitor patient for therapeutic response. Notify provider and intervene as appropriate in the event of an unintended response to medication.
* Perform exceptional care by responding promptly to patient requests. Strive to anticipate patient needs and resolve them proactively.
* Teach patients, families and caregivers about patient medical condition, patient status, treatment plan, medications and possible side effects, and follow\-up measures. Translates complex medical terminology to ensure complete understanding.


 What qualifications you will need:
   

  

* Basic Cardiac Life Support (BLS) obtained within 30 days of employment
* Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) obtained within 1 year of employment
* Other Certifications maybe required during employment
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Nursing to be completed before start date. You may accept a position prior to graduation.
* Registered Nurse License or Graduate Nurse in the State. You may start orientation and training in your RN Resident position prior to passing the NCLEX.
* No previous experience needed
* Some travel maybe needed for training, you will remain local to the Kansas City metro area.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION
This position is a Level II Software Developer supporting R.E. Mason's enterprise applications and software products. The successful candidate will have 3-5 years' experience in software development on enterprise applications and will be a highly communicative, detail-oriented, career-minded individual with the ability to multitask and work with a cross-functional development team. The successful candidate must be customer service oriented, resourceful, and able to take ownership of assignments through completion.
This role includes the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of business applications, web applications, APIs, cloud services, enterprise integrations, ERP solutions, databases, and development automation. The developer will work with business users and technical team members to understand requirements and develop secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions that support company operations and customer-facing products.
In addition to application development, this role will participate in the continued modernization of R.E. Mason's software and integration architecture, including Azure cloud services, event-driven integrations, CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code, data platforms, and other technologies as business needs evolve.
SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES
Understand business and customer requirements and translate them into working code and technical solutions.
Provide recommendations on coding approaches, solution design, and software systems architecture.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support software across frontend, backend, API, integration, database, and cloud layers.
Develop code in multiple languages such as, but not limited to, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python, Java, SQL, PL/SQL, and T-SQL.
Develop and maintain web applications and reusable user-interface components using frameworks such as React.
Create and consume REST/OData APIs, event-driven integrations, and third-party system interfaces.
Develop and support IFS Cloud/ERP solutions and related enterprise applications and integrations.
Develop and deploy Azure solutions and participate in CI/CD automation and source-controlled Infrastructure as Code.
Apply secure development practices including authentication and authorization, secrets management, least-privilege access, and appropriate data or tenant isolation.
Participate in QA test plan development, automated testing, code reviews, release validation, and production support.
Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and support existing and legacy software and integrations.
Gather and evaluate user feedback, recommend and execute improvements, and create technical documentation for reference and reporting.
REQUIRED COMPETENCIES
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Experience with software design, development, testing, and support in an enterprise environment.
Knowledge of one or more coding languages such as TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python, Java, SQL, PL/SQL, or T-SQL and related frameworks/systems.
Experience developing or supporting web applications, APIs, backend services, integrations, or similar enterprise software.
Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and common authentication and authorization concepts.
Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
Prior experience with Git, Bitbucket, or another source control platform and collaborative code review practices.
Understanding of cloud-based application development and deployment; Microsoft Azure experience is strongly preferred.
Understanding of CI/CD and automated deployment practices.
Ability to troubleshoot and debug software across multiple systems and application layers.
Ability to learn new languages, technologies, platforms, and business processes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, resourcefulness, attention to detail, time management skills, and teamwork.
REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
3-5 years' experience in software development on enterprise applications or other business-critical systems.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE / COMPETENCIES
Experience developing full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and backend APIs or services.
Experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automated deployment technologies such as Bicep or Terraform.

Enterprise integration or iPaaS experience with platforms such as MuleSoft/Anypoint, Power Automate, or Boomi.
Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Azure Data Explorer/Kusto, or similar technologies.
